title: Auth in 60 Minutes
description: Wire up JWT-based login and protected routes using Express + Postgres.
problemStatement: Build a /register and /login endpoint. Return a signed JWT on success. Protect a /profile route that returns the logged-in user's data. No libraries like Passport — raw JWT signing only.
expectedOutput: Working Postman collection or curl commands showing register → login → protected route flow.

title: Classify in a CSV
description: Build a text sentiment classifier from a provided CSV dataset using scikit-learn.
problemStatement: Load the provided movie review CSV. Vectorise using TF-IDF. Train a Logistic Regression classifier. Report accuracy, precision, recall, and a confusion matrix on the test split.
expectedOutput: Jupyter notebook with model evaluation and a function that takes any string and returns a sentiment label.

title: State Without a Library
description: Build a multi-step form in React Native using only useState and useReducer.
problemStatement: Create a 3-step onboarding flow: Name & Email → Profile details → Review & Submit. No form library. Validate each step before allowing progression. Show a summary screen on completion.
expectedOutput: Expo Snack link or GitHub repo with working APK/simulator screenshot.

title: Rate-Limited API Gateway
description: Build a reverse proxy with per-user rate limiting, request logging, and Redis-backed counters.
problemStatement: Build an Express middleware layer that sits in front of two mock services. Each API key gets 100 requests/hour. If exceeded, return 429. Log every request to Postgres with method, path, status, and latency. Redis must store counters with TTL.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo with Docker Compose setup. Demo showing rate limit being hit and correct 429 response.

title: From Data to Decision
description: Train, evaluate, and deploy a churn prediction model as a FastAPI endpoint.
problemStatement: Use the provided telecom churn dataset. Feature engineer, handle class imbalance (SMOTE is allowed), train XGBoost, and expose a /predict endpoint via FastAPI that accepts a JSON payload of customer features and returns churn probability + explanation (top 3 SHAP features).
expectedOutput: FastAPI app runnable via uvicorn. /predict returns {churn_probability, top_features}.

title: Offline-First Notes App
description: Build a note-taking app that works offline and syncs when back online using SQLite + Supabase.
problemStatement: Build a notes app with local SQLite storage. When network is available, sync unsynced notes to Supabase. Handle conflicts (last-write-wins). Show sync status per note (synced/pending/error).
expectedOutput: GitHub repo. Show offline creation then online sync in a screen recording.

title: Paginate Like a Pro
description: Implement cursor-based pagination on a Node API serving 100K+ records.
problemStatement: Given a seeded Postgres table of 100,000 products, build a /products endpoint with cursor-based (keyset) pagination. The cursor must be opaque (base64-encoded). Include total count, next cursor, and prev cursor in the response.
expectedOutput: Postman collection showing forward and backward pagination. Query time must be under 20ms at any cursor position.

title: Retrieval in 45 Minutes
description: Build a semantic search over a small document set using sentence embeddings + cosine similarity.
problemStatement: Given 200 Wikipedia article chunks, embed them with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and index in FAISS. Build a search function that returns the top 5 most relevant chunks for a query. No OpenAI API allowed.
expectedOutput: Python script or notebook. search("What is quantum entanglement?") returns 5 ranked passages.

title: Custom Animated Tab Bar
description: Build a custom bottom tab bar with spring animations and an active indicator.
problemStatement: Implement a custom bottom navigation with 4 tabs. The active tab indicator must animate with a spring physics curve (Reanimated 2). Long-pressing a tab should show a haptic feedback pulse. No third-party nav UI libraries.
expectedOutput: Expo Snack or GitHub repo with a 10-second screen recording showing animations.

title: Real-Time Collaborative Doc
description: Build a collaborative text editor where two users see each other's cursor in real time.
problemStatement: Build a shared text editor using Yjs CRDT + WebSocket provider. Multiple browser tabs should reflect text changes with < 100ms latency. Show live cursors with usernames. Persist document state to Redis.
expectedOutput: Deployed URL or Docker Compose setup. Screen recording of two tabs editing simultaneously.

title: Build Your Own RAG
description: Implement a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline from scratch — no LangChain.
problemStatement: Chunk, embed, and store 10 research papers in a vector database (Chroma or FAISS). On query, retrieve top-k chunks and pass them as context to Gemini Flash. The system must cite which paper each answer came from. No LangChain or LlamaIndex.
expectedOutput: CLI or API. query("What is the main finding of paper X?") returns answer + citation(s).

title: Camera to Cloud
description: Build a photo capture app that uploads to Supabase Storage with a thumbnail pipeline.
problemStatement: Build an app that captures photos, compresses them client-side (max 500KB), uploads to Supabase Storage, and generates a 200px thumbnail. Show upload progress. Display a gallery of all uploaded photos with lazy loading.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo + screen recording of capture → compress → upload → gallery flow.

title: Webhook Reliability
description: Build a webhook delivery system with retries, exponential backoff, and delivery logs.
problemStatement: Build a system that receives events and fans them out to registered webhook URLs. Failed deliveries must retry 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 4s, 16s). Log every attempt (URL, status, latency, body) to Postgres.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo. Demo showing a failing endpoint causing retries, then succeeding on attempt 3.

title: Fine-tune a Classifier
description: Fine-tune a DistilBERT model on a provided 500-sample dataset.
problemStatement: Given 500 labelled customer support tickets (5 categories), fine-tune distilbert-base-uncased for classification. Must reach >85% validation accuracy. Use HuggingFace Trainer API. Export the model for inference.
expectedOutput: Notebook with training curves + final eval metrics. Inference function loadable from saved model directory.

title: Push Notifications That Work
description: Integrate Expo push notifications with a Node backend that sends targeted messages.
problemStatement: Register device tokens on app launch, store in Postgres via a Node API. Build a /notify endpoint that accepts a user ID and message, then sends a push notification to all devices registered to that user. Handle token expiry.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo for both app and server. Demo video showing notification delivered to a physical device.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Foundation
description: Design and build the data isolation layer for a multi-tenant application.
problemStatement: Implement tenant isolation using Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS). Each tenant's data must be invisible to others without application-level filtering. Build middleware that sets the tenant context from the JWT claim. Include a test that proves cross-tenant data leakage is impossible.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo with RLS policies, middleware, and a test suite that fails if isolation breaks.

title: Agent With Memory
description: Build a task-executing AI agent with tool use and persistent conversation memory.
problemStatement: Build an agent that can: search Wikipedia, perform arithmetic, and read/write a key-value memory store. The agent must decide which tool to call based on the user query. Conversation history must persist across sessions in a JSON file. No LangChain.
expectedOutput: CLI agent. Must correctly answer a multi-step question that requires at least 2 tool calls.

title: Maps & Geofencing
description: Build a location-aware app with live tracking, geofencing alerts, and a heat map.
problemStatement: Build an app that tracks the user's location in the background (15s intervals), draws the path on a map, and triggers a local notification when they enter or exit a defined geofence radius. Show a heat map of the path density over time.
expectedOutput: GitHub repo + 30-second screen recording showing path tracking and geofence alert trigger.
